name: team_planning_cost
description: Get what a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in costs over its period, beside the baseline priced over the same days, with the difference. Each seat (a person, or the FTE a position's occupants leave open) is priced at the midpoint of the pay band for its level and country (else the band for any location), made yearly (a month is 1/12, an hour takes the working_hours rule), scaled by FTE and by the days it is held out of 365, plus the on_cost rule of its unit. A person is priced at their own level, a planned one winning, and at their position's level only when theirs resolves to none; level_source says which. A leaver costs up to their leaving date and their backfill from the day after. Totals are per currency in `native`, and `converted` is the same in the reference currency at the period's start, null with `missing` saying why when a rate is missing. Units count their own places, with null for no unit; `with_below` adds the units below. Cost centres use null for no cost centre. Unit, cost-centre and plan totals always agree. A seat that can't be priced is in `unpriced` with its reason, never counted as zero. Pass unit_id for the working of each seat in that unit. Plans reprice live: bands_changed_at says when a band last changed. pay_view is band_ranges for a member with the see-pay right, whose working shows each band's minimum and maximum, and band_midpoints for everyone else. For a holder, a person whose actual pay the plan holds is priced from it instead (made yearly, scaled by FTE only when its basis is full_time, by the days held, plus on-cost): each seat's pay_source says actual or band_midpoint, and actual_pay_seats counts the seats priced from actual pay. Held pay the plan lost with the person's key leaves the seat unpriced as pay_unknown. Everyone else is priced at midpoints throughout, so the two views total differently. The baseline has no period, so it can't be the scenario. Figures are decimal strings; people are named by id in `names`. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: A scenario of the plan; not the plan's id, as the baseline has no period.

unit_id.description: A unit on the scenario's or the baseline's map, for the working of each seat in it.
